title: [VSC-16] Packaging: one bundle manifest shared by the VS Code and JetBrains builds
description:
Epic epic-aabc654d (VS Code works + plugin reuse), sliced by task-a3e414a3 (VSC-0). No dependencies; files disjoint from every other row in the epic.

Objective: both plugins bundle the same runtime (daemon dist + node_modules, proxy dist + node_modules, agent scripts, local-runner assets, mods, role docs, agent-context, skills) from two hand-kept lists: moe-vscode/scripts/bundle-assets.mjs and moe-jetbrains/build.gradle.kts (tasks.named<PrepareSandboxTask>("prepareSandbox")). They have drifted: VS Code ships only docs/roles/{architect,qa,worker}.md while JetBrains ships every file under docs/roles (governor and the *.reference.md companions too). Move the shared part into one JSON manifest that both builds read.

Deliverable: new scripts/bundle-manifest.json listing the bundled script files and directories with their excludes, and the docs to copy; bundle-assets.mjs and build.gradle.kts both read it (Gradle can parse it with groovy.json.JsonSlurper, which the Gradle runtime ships), keeping their existing fresh-dist and required-asset checks and the CRLF to LF normalisation of .sh files. JetBrains first: change and verify the Gradle build before bundle-assets.mjs. The shipped JetBrains file set must not change; the VS Code set may only gain the role docs JetBrains already ships.

Not in scope: pruning devDependencies from the bundled node_modules (both plugins ship vitest and typescript today; the vsix was 61 MB at 882a4c39), CI (VSC-17), the content of any wrapper script.

Verification (GLOBAL rail: no in-place builds or installs): build in a git-archive snapshot outside the checkout whose absolute path has NO UUID-shaped segment, e.g. /mnt/d/moe-scratch/vsc16-<sha>. npm 12 redacts UUID-shaped path segments in `npm list` output, so vsce then collects zero files and `npm run package` fails with "Extension entrypoint(s) missing" (seen 2026-11-02 in a Claude scratchpad path). In the snapshot: `npm ci && npm run build` in packages/moe-daemon and packages/moe-proxy, `npm ci && npm run package` in moe-vscode, then under the jetbrains-gradle lease `cmd.exe /d /c 'set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d D:\moe-scratch\vsc16-<sha>\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test buildPlugin --rerun'`. Build the base commit the same way, compare sorted `unzip -Z1` listings of both zips and both vsix files, and run `node scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs <unzipped bundled dir>` on the new zip and vsix.
definitionOfDone: scripts/bundle-manifest.json exists, and moe-vscode/scripts/bundle-assets.mjs and moe-jetbrains/build.gradle.kts both read their script, local-runner, mods and docs lists from it, with no duplicated list left in either file.
The JetBrains plugin zip built from this diff has exactly the same sorted `unzip -Z1` listing as the zip built from the base commit.
The .vsix built from this diff differs from the base .vsix only by added docs/roles files that the JetBrains zip already ships (listing diff in the summary).
`node scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs` passes against the unzipped JetBrains moe-jetbrains dir and the unzipped vsix's extension/bundled dir.
In the snapshot, under the jetbrains-gradle lease, `gradlew.bat test buildPlugin --rerun` reports BUILD SUCCESSFUL and moe-vscode `npm run package` exits 0.

implementationPlan.description:
Create scripts/bundle-manifest.json, the one list of scripts and docs both plugin builds bundle (DoD 1). Write it as 2-space JSON with LF line endings and a final newline. It has exactly two top-level members, comment and copies.

comment (one string): The scripts and docs both IDE plugins bundle. moe-jetbrains/build.gradle.kts (prepareSandbox) and moe-vscode/scripts/bundle-assets.mjs both read this file. Each copy goes from `from` (repo-relative) to `into` (bundle-relative). With `files`, it copies exactly those files, each of which must exist, and LF-normalises any .sh among them. Without `files`, it copies the whole directory minus `exclude` (Ant-style patterns relative to `from`, the syntax Gradle's exclude() takes), and each `required` file must exist. A missing source, or a path that is absolute or has a .. segment, fails both builds. The daemon and proxy copies stay in each build, next to their fresh-dist checks.

copies, in this order, one object each:
1. from scripts, into scripts, files: moe-agent.ps1, moe-agent.sh, moe-call.sh, prompt-cache.mjs, prompt-cache-policy.mjs, prompt-cache-usage.mjs, prompt-cache-witness.mjs, usage-receipt.mjs, usage-session.mjs, usage-report.mjs, analyze-usage.mjs, moe-account-lease.mjs.
2. from scripts/local-runner, into scripts/local-runner, required: certified-provider.json, multipass.mjs, doctor.mjs, cli.mjs, vm-control.mjs; exclude: **/*.test.*, **/*.spec.*, **/tests/**, **/__tests__/**, **/fixtures/**, **/__fixtures__/**.
3. from scripts/mods, into scripts/mods, exclude: **/*.test.ts, */.claude-plugin/types/**.
4. from docs/roles, into docs/roles.
5. from docs, into docs, files: agent-context.md.
6. from docs/skills, into docs/skills.

Why this shape:
- The 12 script names are today's VS Code list. Gradle ships the same 12 files through its prompt-cache*.mjs glob plus explicit names.
- The excludes are today's Gradle patterns, rebased from scripts/ to each entry's own directory. JetBrains is the reference, because its zip listing must not change (DoD 2).
- docs/roles is the whole directory: that is the intended G10 fix. VS Code gains the 5 role docs JetBrains already ships: architect.reference.md, governor.md, governor.reference.md, qa.reference.md and worker.reference.md (DoD 3).
- The member names copies, from, into, files, required and exclude are a contract: VSC-17 (task-6a0f0be3) will check the vsix against them.

Error handling and test: none at this step. Both consumers validate the shape (steps 2 and 3), and step 3's test pins this content.

Code:
1. Delete the vals bundledAgentScript, bundledAgentScriptSh, bundledCallScriptSh, bundledRoleDocs, bundledAgentContext, bundledSkillsDir and bundledLocalRunnerDir.
2. Parse the manifest once:
   - Add a small data class BundleCopy(from, into, files, required, exclude) and a top-level `val bundleCopies: List<BundleCopy> by lazy { ... }`.
   - Parse with groovy.json.JsonSlurper().parseText(<repoRoot>/scripts/bundle-manifest.json read as text). groovy-json-4.0.33.jar ships in Gradle 9.8.2's lib, so no buildscript dependency is needed.
   - Error handling: throw GradleException with the message `Bundle manifest <path> is malformed: <what>`, naming the key (for example copies[2].exclude), when:
     - the file is missing or does not parse;
     - copies is not a non-empty array;
     - an entry is not an object;
     - from or into is not a non-empty string;
     - files, required or exclude is present but not an array of non-empty strings;
     - any from, into, files or required value is absolute, starts with / or \, or has a .. segment.
   - An absent files, required or exclude means empty. There are no other defaults.
3. requireBundledAssets():
   - Replace the moe-agent.ps1/.sh/moe-call.sh checks and the local-runner listOf(...).forEach loop with ONE loop over bundleCopies.
   - The from dir must be a directory, and every files + required name must be a file (isFile, so a directory masquerading as a module still fails).
   - Messages: `Bundled <from>/<name> not found at <dir>.`, or `Bundled <from> not found at <dir>.` for the directory.
   - The daemon/proxy checks and requireFreshDist stay untouched.
4. prepareSandbox:
   - Replace the from(bundledAgentScript), from(repoRoot.resolve(scripts)) {...}, from(listOf(bundledAgentScriptSh, bundledCallScriptSh)), from(bundledRoleDocs), from(bundledAgentContext) and from(bundledSkillsDir) blocks with ONE loop over bundleCopies:
     - an entry with files: from(those files, resolved against from) into $pluginContentRoot/<into>, with the existing FixCrLfFilter eol=lf filter applied through filesMatching(**/*.sh). Keep the CRLF comment.
     - any other entry: from(the from dir) into $pluginContentRoot/<into>, exclude(its exclude list).
   - The daemon/proxy dist, node_modules and package.json blocks stay byte-identical: the bundle test regex-checks the dist blocks.
5. Add one comment above the parse: moe-vscode/scripts/bundle-assets.mjs reads the same manifest, and its comment member states the rules. Nowhere in this file may you write a manifest file name or a multi-segment from path (scripts/local-runner, scripts/mods, docs/roles, docs/skills). implementationPlan.note:
Adversarial self-review.

PARITY
- Excludes: on the real trees, the zip listing is identical and the vsix's scripts/** CRCs are identical to base, so local-runner and mods select the same paths in both builds. 12 antPattern probe rows passed, including:
  - the dot directory a/.claude-plugin/x.test.ts;
  - 'tests' matching **/tests/**;
  - 'contests/x' not matching;
  - */.claude-plugin/types matching the dir itself and its children, but not a/b/.claude-plugin/types/x.
- The path.matchesGlob mutant fails 4 tests.
- .sh files are LF in both builds. Gradle: a CRLF moe-call.sh shipped with 0 CRs. Node: test (f), with the plain-cp mutant and the no-chmod mutant each failing it.
- Refusal happens before any copy:
  - Gradle: a missing source fails in prepareSandbox doFirst, before the Sync copies; a malformed manifest fails at prepareSandbox configuration, through the lazy val.
  - Node: the check runs right after the output dir is reset, before the daemon copy. Test (g) asserts bundled/daemon is absent.

CROSS-PLATFORM
- The cp filter does replaceAll('\\','/') on path.relative before matching.
- Windows Gradle resolved the forward-slash `from` values (the zip proves it).
- path.join normalises forward-slash froms on Windows Node.
- CRLF is covered as above.

ODD MANIFESTS (no code added)
- Empty exclude: both builds copy everything.
- A files entry with exclude: both builds ignore exclude (Gradle takes the include branch; Node's file loop never reads it).
- Two entries sharing an into: disjoint files merge in both. A clashing file name fails Gradle (Sync duplicate handling) and is last-wins in Node.
- An exclude of '*' or '**/*' also matches Node's root (''), so Node copies nothing, and Gradle copies nothing for those patterns either.
- JSON null for files/required/exclude means empty in both.

NO DUPLICATED LIST
- Test (d) passes.
- A grep of both build files for moe-agent|moe-call|prompt-cache|usage-|local-runner|mods|roles|skills|agent-context|vm-control|doctor|multipass|certified finds nothing.
- No other code references the removed Gradle vals. MoeProjectInitializer's optional docs/agent-context.md load returns null when the file is absent: unchanged, because it was never shipped.

SIZE (numstat)
- docs +5/-6, gradle +63/-53, bundler +81/-63, test +60/-16, manifest +42 (wc -l 42).
- Total +251/-138: net +113 (≤150) and 389 changed lines (≤400).

GIT STATUS

comments.author: architect-d54b05fd
comments.content:
@architect-0fcb7226 I'm planning VSC-17 (task-6a0f0be3), which consumes this row's scripts/bundle-manifest.json. Its CI step must "fail when any file the bundle manifest lists is missing from the vsix", and I'd like that check not to re-implement the copy rules a third time, after bundle-assets.mjs and build.gradle.kts. One request for the schema: give every entry an explicit bundle-relative target path, plus whether it is a file or a directory, with any excludes. For example:
`{ "from": "scripts/moe-agent.sh", "to": "scripts/moe-agent.sh", "kind": "file" }`
`{ "from": "scripts/local-runner", "to": "scripts/local-runner", "kind": "dir", "exclude": [...] }`
Then VSC-17 checks that each file entry's `to` is in the vsix under extension/bundled/, and that each directory entry's `to` is non-empty there, with every file bundle-assets.mjs copied under it present. If you settle on different field names, VSC-17's plan maps its check to whatever field names the bundle target, so one clearly named target field per entry is all it needs. Also note: bundle-assets.mjs today silently skips a missing agent script (`if (await exists(src))`). A listed-but-missing source would be worth failing on in the bundler, as the required local-runner assets already do.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: Both IDE plugin builds bundle their scripts, local-runner assets, mods and docs from one list, scripts/bundle-manifest.json, so a newly bundled file is added once. The JetBrains zip's entry listing does not change. The .vsix gains only the docs/roles files the zip already ships (architect.reference.md, governor.md, governor.reference.md, qa.reference.md and worker.reference.md). Either build refuses to bundle, naming the problem, when a source the manifest lists is missing or when the manifest is malformed (empty copies, a non-string member, or an absolute or .. path).
acceptanceCriteria: Adding a script name to the manifest's scripts entry ships it in both bundles, with no edit to either build file.
The JetBrains zip built from this diff has the same sorted unzip -Z1 listing as the base zip.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1. Generate the two build files' lists from the manifest at build time (codegen). Rejected: an extra build step, when both builds can just read JSON.
2. Use path.matchesGlob on the Node side. Rejected: on Node 24.21 its ** does not enter dot directories, and `**/tests/**` does not match `tests` itself. Gradle (Ant) matches both. A 4-line Ant matcher, probed on 16 rows, keeps one pattern syntax for both builds.
3. Put the daemon/proxy dist and node_modules copies in the manifest too. Rejected: each build keeps its own fresh-dist and marker checks, and DoD 1 names only the script, local-runner, mods and docs lists.
4. Keep VS Code's copy-only-when-present behaviour for scripts and docs. Rejected: one strict rule in both builds is simpler, it stops a silent omission, and every listed source is tracked in git.
5. Allow globs in files (prompt-cache*.mjs). Rejected: an explicit list plus test (c), which requires every scripts/prompt-cache*.mjs to be listed, keeps Gradle's auto-pickup guarantee with no glob expansion in files.
